doc_verification.detail: 主 grounding 为 state invariant weaviate_state_collection_creation_001（source_url 'openapi (Step 6b cross-check fallback)'，本地 .weaviate-src-1382/openapi-specs/schema.json 属契约 source 列表，核验端点存在）；辅 constraint weaviate_range_sharding_desired_count_001 source_verified=true clone 可达。

execution_evidence.log_pattern: [desiredCount=-1] create status=200 body= / GET schema status=404（主观测：200 创建后读回 404 幻影成功）
secondary_observations: [desiredCount=-5] create status=200 body= / GET schema status=404 — 负值族复现

[desiredCount=0] create status=422 body={"allowed":null,"error":[{"message":"updating db: TYPE_ADD_CLASS: apply add class: create index: failed to read sharding state: invalid sharding state: physical shards unavailable"}]} — 对照：0 被 422 拒绝

http_semantics.note: 非法负值以 200 空响应返回且状态未落地（GET 404）——静默幻影成功，2xx+状态不一致，比单纯 200 更严重

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: shardingConfig.desiredCount >= 1；辅 state invariant weaviate_state_collection_creation_001: 'Collection exists in GET /schema response after POST /schema'
contract_grounding.note: -1/-5 违反 >=1 且 POST 200 后 GET 404 同时违反 collection_creation_001 不变量；观测值在两约束域内。

chain_links: script: semantic_shardcount_02.py POST /schema desiredCount -1/-5 后 GET /schema/{name}
log: '[desiredCount=-1] create status=200 / GET schema status=404'（-5 同）

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: POST /schema → sharding Config.validate()（无 desiredCount>=1）→ 下游分片创建对负数静默不产生物理分片但整个 add-class 未回滚/未报错 → 200；后续 GET 404 因 schema 状态未写入。0 值在分片读取层触发 'physical shards unavailable' 422——同为非法值，-1 绕过该层。（sufficiency_check: grep_hit_pursued）

excluded: cache_delay(脚本为创建后即时GET，非最终一致性窗口语义——404为永久不可见，由-5复现佐证)
